James Hetfield

Real/full name:
James Alan Hetfield
Age:
62 (born Aug 3rd, 1963)
Place of birth:
United States (Downey, California)
Gender:
Male

Biography

James Hetfield is one of the founding members of Metallica, and one of the only 2 remaining members of the original line up (the other member being Lars Ulrich).

Hetfield has cited Led Zeppelin, Black Sabbath, AC/DC, Motörhead, Thin Lizzy, Ted Nugent, The Beatles, and Deep Purple as musical influences. However, Aerosmith is the band he identifies as having been the main musical influence on ...
Read more

Trivia

James plays and has played Gibson, ESP, and Jackson guitars.

He came up with and drew the original Metallica logo.

James has been known to skateboard and has had numerous accidents. Because of this, his management company Q Prime added a clause in his contract saying he is not allowed to skateboard while Metallica is on tour.

He's the father of Castor Hetfield.
